_comment: Claims a review wisp and writes the REVIEW verdict on its linked node. The wisp's parent is that node under the documented `bd create --parent <node> --ephemeral` shape (bd refuses a relates-to from a child to its own parent); a relates-to or replies-to link counts as well. The verdict is one line on the node, `REVIEW <node> dimension=<d> verdict=approve|changes head_sha=<sha> review_round=<n>`, with head_sha and review_round copied from the wisp's metadata (the node's when the wisp lacks one): G4 counts only a REVIEW carrying both tokens for the current head and round, and its refusal names the missing or mismatched token and the expected values. Approval closes the wisp; changes release it open for the next round. Neither ends the claim for the exit gate: a closed or released wisp is still judged on the node's REVIEW. It claims the WISP, never the node, so a handed-off node never has to enter this role's queue. ROUTING: metadata.role is deliberately absent from deny_metadata. That list is a presence test read as authorship, sound only for outcome fields no dispatcher stamps. Routing must be stamped or the bead reaches no queue, so a denial here would fault every worker on every bead. G5 enforces it at the write seam instead, where only the architect may re-point a route. `bd create` stays exempt, so a routable bug bead can still be filed.
